title: Common representatives in ring and abelian pullbacks
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be continuous, $\mathcal O$ a presheaf of commutative rings and $\mathcal A$ a presheaf of abelian groups on $Y$, with pullbacks and coprojections as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. For every open $U\subseteq X$, $a\in f_p\mathcal O(U)$ and $g\in f_p\mathcal A(U)$, there exist an open $V\subseteq Y$, $h:U\subseteq f^{-1}V$, $b\in\mathcal O(V)$ and $t\in\mathcal A(V)$ such that $\iota^U_V(b)=a$ and $\iota^U_V(t)=g$.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: The costructured-arrow neighbourhood category at U is filtered: top is an index, intersection gives a common receiving index, and parallel morphisms agree by thinness of Opens.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: The pointwise Kan-extension unit supplies colimit cocones for O and A. Forgetful functors from CommRingCat and Ab preserve filtered colimits. Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep gives one representative for each section.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Take IsFiltered.max of the two indices and restrict their sections along leftToMax and rightToMax. The two cocone identities preserve the representative images and give the required common open.

mathlib_searches.verdict: The Type-valued pair lemma treats one diagram. Apply Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep twice for the ring and abelian diagrams and take a common later index.
The representative and pointwise-colimit lemmas match the two ingredients; filteredness and common-index glue are proved in Lean.

from.place: Module base-change clause of def-pc-base-change, via step 1 of the presheaf module inverse-image adjunction: common neighbourhood representatives.

lean.statement: theorem topologicalPullbackCommonRepresentatives {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (O : Y.Presheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (A : Y.Presheaf Ab.{u}) (U : Opens X) (x : ((TopCat.Presheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} f).obj O).obj (op U)) (y : ((TopCat.Presheaf.pullback Ab.{u} f).obj A).obj (op U)) : let ι := fun (C : Type (u + 1)) [Category.{u} C] [HasColimits C] (A : Y.Presheaf C) (U : Opens X) (V : Opens Y) (h : U ≤ (Opens.map f).obj V) => ((TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C f).unit.app A).app (op V) ≫ ((TopCat.Presheaf.pullback C f).obj A).map (homOfLE h).op ∃ (V : Opens Y) (h : U ≤ (Opens.map f).obj V) (a : O.obj (op V)) (g : A.obj (op V)), (ι CommRingCat.{u} O U V h).hom a = x ∧ (ι Ab.{u} A U V h).hom g = y
